scope: Adapter TagDuel puro para Barrel Behind the Door: redireciona para o time adversário o dano que uma ativação de Magia/Armadilha/efeito de Monstro causaria ao time controlador da Counter Trap. A saída é uma diretiva de redirecionamento, não aplicação de LP. Quatro caminhos novos; sem resolver, catálogo, certificação, inventário ou dados persistentes.

card.name: Barrel Behind the Door
card.officialEffect: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated that would inflict damage to you: Your opponent takes the damage instead.

plannedTests: Spell, Trap and monster-effect activations that would damage the controller team redirect the exact amount to the opposing team
battle damage and non-activated/continuous damage are excluded
only the controller team can be the original damage recipient
the Counter Trap must have been Set face-down and be face-up in its controller's backrow during resolution
negated Counter Trap activation or negated/non-resolving source effect produces no redirect
zero damage, already-applied damage and malformed chain receipts fail closed
duplicate activation receipt is idempotent; distinct Counter Trap activations against one source effect remain separate directives, not additive damage
stale shared LP snapshot, duplicate UIDs and invalid physical UID prefixes are rejected
no mutation of player LP, private hands, decks, 3+3 zones, Field Zone or Extra Deck
nextTask: Implementar Barrel Behind the Door como redirecionador de dano de efeito ativado, com snapshot de cadeia/LP, validação da armadilha Set, idempotência e 20+ testes; executar CI isolada.
